item.title: Show & Tell Session 1
item.description: This Show & Tell was a part of a series a coworker and I put together to help colleagues get more acquainted with R and overcome the scary feeling we all had when learning to code. Introduction Data Visualization is a super important (and super fun) part of any project. Understand our data Understand what we are doing to the data Share with others Today’s agenda Answer questions with data viz Explore what R has to offer Look at some other R visualizations First steps Let’s get a glimpe of the data.
